post.description: Customer session and current customer membership; parent request must belong to the customer. Requires verified email and an open editable draft. Replaces its single draft attachment; historical references retain old bytes. Returns 201 for original request and identical idempotent replay. Reservation expires after 10 minutes.

ETag.description: Strong ETag of the parent project request; document.version is independent and must not be substituted.

put.description: Customer session and current customer membership; parent request must belong to the customer. Requires verified email, editable draft and its current attachment. Send raw bytes with exactly application/octet-stream, never multipart. Size and SHA-256 must match reservation. PUT finalizes atomically after storage and authorization recheck; response normally quarantined. Same immutable bytes may be replayed before expiry. No separate finalize endpoint.

ETag.description: Strong ETag of the parent project request; document.version is independent and must not be substituted.

get.description: Customer session and current customer membership; parent request must belong to the customer. May poll same-parent metadata including removed/tombstone records. No storage locator or private URL is returned.

ETag.description: Strong ETag of the parent project request; document.version is independent and must not be substituted.

delete.description: Customer session and current customer membership; parent request must belong to the customer. Verified owner with open draft. Detaches current attachment; unreferenced bytes enter deleting. If a submitted revision/proposal/AI reference retains the document, response keeps existing state; removal is not a promise of physical deletion.

ETag.description: Strong ETag of the parent project request; document.version is independent and must not be substituted.

get.description: Current customer membership and current draft or historical attachment required. Only available documents stream; other states return 409. Download authority and immutable object version rechecked before first byte.

get.description: Verified customer with ai.self.use or verified staff with ai.use, plus current parent scope (request intake.read for staff; project projects.self.read or projects.read and document-read permission). All runs are private to their requesting actor. Required parent_type and parent_id; id ascending keyset after/limit, no search/sort/state filter. This list is run summaries, without suggestion output.

post.description: Verified customer with ai.self.use or verified staff with ai.use, plus current parent scope (request intake.read for staff; project projects.self.read or projects.read and document-read permission). All runs are private to their requesting actor. Consent must be literal JSON true. If-Match is the PARENT ETag. Customers use an editable request draft; staff request sources are submitted revisions and disallow improve_description/suggest_category. Project parents require document_id and analyze_document/extract_requirements/missing_information. analyze_document always requires available document. Text purposes cannot use a document. HTTP202 also returns state unavailable for disabled provider, exhausted budget or run limits. Submission has no AI dependency; a disabled optional control must never block it.

202.description: Durable run accepted, including terminal unavailable result when AI is disabled or capacity/budget disallows work.

ETag.description: AI run ETag (different from parent ETag used for creation).

get.description: Verified customer with ai.self.use or verified staff with ai.use, plus current parent scope (request intake.read for staff; project projects.self.read or projects.read and document-read permission). All runs are private to their requesting actor. Revalidates current parent and any document access. suggestion is null until a successful result exists. Run state stays succeeded after apply/dismiss; inspect suggestion.state. Staleness is checked when applying, not a persisted stale enum.

ETag.description: AI run ETag used by subsequent apply/dismiss/cancel.

post.description: Verified customer with ai.self.use or verified staff with ai.use, plus current parent scope (request intake.read for staff; project projects.self.read or projects.read and document-read permission). All runs are private to their requesting actor. Also ai.self.apply for customer or ai.apply AND discovery.manage for staff. Customer application only improves own request draft description/category. Staff application only appends extracted requirements to an editable discovery_revision_id for the same submitted source revision. Project document results and other purposes are advisory only (409 on apply). If source version/hash/document/authorization changed,409; stale run ETag412. No silent edits.

ETag.description: Updated AI run ETag. Refetch parent after successful application to receive its new ETag.

post.description: Verified customer with ai.self.use or verified staff with ai.use, plus current parent scope (request intake.read for staff; project projects.self.read or projects.read and document-read permission). All runs are private to their requesting actor. Requires succeeded run and pending suggestion; marks suggestion dismissed, leaves run succeeded. Exact receipt replay preserves original result.

ETag.description: AI run ETag.

post.description: Verified customer with ai.self.use or verified staff with ai.use, plus current parent scope (request intake.read for staff; project projects.self.read or projects.read and document-read permission). All runs are private to their requesting actor. Only pending/processing runs may cancel. Returns cancelled and nullable suggestion_state. Cancellation prevents applying later provider output; no automatic external retry on uncertain outcomes.

ETag.description: AI run ETag.
